title: 여신전문금융업법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1

Article 3 (Methods for Disclosing Transaction Terms, etc.)
① In accordance with Article 18 of the Act, a credit card company must inform credit card members, direct payment card members, or prepaid card holders (hereinafter referred to as "credit card members") and the credit card merchant about the matters specified in each item of Article 18 of the Act, in accordance with the following classifications. <Amended October 15, 2012, August 5, 2020>
1. The various rates specified in Article 18, Item 1 (hereinafter referred to as "various rates") must be disclosed to credit card members and direct payment card members using the following methods:
a. Various rates applied by the credit card company based on the credit rating, personal credit score, and overdue period of credit card members or direct payment card members: Convert the various rates into annual rates (年率) and post them on the internet website of the credit card company and the Credit Union established under Article 62 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "the Credit Union").
b. In the case of issuing a new credit card or billing for its use, the various rates applicable to the credit card member are notified to the credit card member individually.
c. The Credit Union

Fees for credit card merchants based on the classification method: To be posted on the internet websites of the relevant credit card companies and associations within one month after the end of each quarter.

2. Items 2 to 4 of Article 18 of the Act shall be implemented using at least two of the following methods, including the method in subparagraph (a):
(a) Notification to credit card members and merchants individually
(b) Announcement in newspapers widely distributed nationwide
(c) Posting on the business premises and internet websites of credit card companies
3. Items 1, 2, and 4 of Article 2 shall be posted on the internet websites of the relevant credit card companies and associations within one month after the end of each quarter, while items 3 of the same article shall be posted within one month after the end of each month.

② In Article 18 of the Act, "matters as determined by the Prime Minister's decree" refers to the following: <amended on 2012.10.15>
1. The ratio of income, such as fees for credit card companies' financial transactions with credit card members, by type (the total income of interest, fees, etc. incurred during the quarter as a percentage of the total amount of funds lent during the quarter)

(Referring to the converted figures)
2. Distribution of credit ratings applied to credit card members
3. Distribution of credit ratings and interest rates for credit card members who have borrowed funds
4. Number of inactive credit cards (as defined in Article 7(2)(3) of the Act), the proportion of inactive credit cards relative to the total number of credit cards, and the procedures for canceling inactive credit cards

③ The Financial Supervisory Commission may issue regulations specifying the necessary matters related to the methods for publishing and notifying various interest rates as defined in Article 1(1).
